access: Plain files; NumPy-only replay reads these without credentials or simulation libraries
interpretation: Reading and arithmetic replay do not independently regenerate the archived forces, quadrature integrands, or trajectories
missing_value_semantics: No missing numeric values; false gates are scientific records, not absent data
reuse: New extraction and replay follow the public benchmark MIT license; original solver dependencies retain their own licenses
pairing: Static force targets include coincident reversal partners. Live cases share fixed initial pair draws; coarse/fine share sample. Action-support replicates are eight whole libraries.

seeds.support: Eight original frozen libraries; see recorded growth/randomized protocols
